info.description: Atomically updates the specified Service configurations.
info.title: Firebase App Check API

requests.description: Accepts an App Attest assertion and an artifact previously obtained from ExchangeAppAttestAttestation and verifies those with Apple. If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeAppAttestAssertion
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Accepts an App Attest CBOR attestation and verifies it with Apple using your preconfigured team and bundle IDs. If valid, returns an attestation artifact that can later be exchanged for an AppCheckToken using ExchangeAppAttestAssertion. For convenience and performance, this method's response object will also contain an AppCheckToken (if the verification is successful).
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeAppAttestAttestation
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates a custom token signed using your project's Admin SDK service account credentials. If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeCustomToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates a debug token secret that you have previously created using CreateDebugToken. If valid, returns an AppCheckToken. Note that a restrictive quota is enforced on this method to prevent accidental exposure of the app to abuse.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeDebugToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Accepts a [`device_token`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck/dcdevice) issued by DeviceCheck, and attempts to validate it with Apple. If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeDeviceCheckToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates an [integrity verdict response token from Play Integrity](https://developer.android.com/google/play/integrity/verdict#decrypt-verify). If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangePlayIntegrityToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates a [reCAPTCHA Enterprise response token](https://cloud.google.com/recaptcha-enterprise/docs/create-assessment#retrieve_token). If valid, returns an App Check token AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeRecaptchaEnterpriseToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates a [reCAPTCHA v3 response token](https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/docs/v3). If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeRecaptchaToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates a [reCAPTCHA v3 response token](https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/docs/v3). If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeRecaptchaV3Token
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Validates a [SafetyNet token](https://developer.android.com/training/safetynet/attestation#request-attestation-step). If valid, returns an AppCheckToken.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:exchangeSafetyNetToken
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Generates a challenge that protects the integrity of an immediately following call to ExchangeAppAttestAttestation or ExchangeAppAttestAssertion. A challenge should not be reused for multiple calls.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:generateAppAttestChallenge
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Generates a challenge that protects the integrity of an immediately following integrity verdict request to the Play Integrity API. The next call to ExchangePlayIntegrityToken using the resulting integrity token will verify the presence and validity of the challenge. A challenge should not be reused for multiple calls.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{app}:generatePlayIntegrityChallenge
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the specified DebugToken. A deleted debug token cannot be used to exchange for an App Check token. Use this method when you suspect the secret `token` has been compromised or when you no longer need the debug token.
requests.name: DELETE /v1beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the Service configuration for the specified service name.
requests.name: GET /v1beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the specified Service configuration.
requests.name: PATCH /v1beta/{name}

requests.description: Creates a new DebugToken for the specified app. For security reasons, after the creation operation completes, the `token` field cannot be updated or retrieved, but you can revoke the debug token using DeleteDebugToken. Each app can have a maximum of 20 debug tokens.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{parent}/debugTokens
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_APP_CHECK_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists all Service configurations for the specified project. Only Services which were explicitly configured using UpdateService or BatchUpdateServices will be returned.
requests.name: GET /v1beta/{parent}/services
